workSection.headline: Kaam Jo Numbers Pe Baat Kare
workSection.subhead: Content Integrity Rule: Hum kabhi fake clients ya made-up numbers nahi dikhate. Yeh hamare structured case-study slots hain — ready to showcase verified before/after outcomes.

processSection.headline: 6-Step Process: Baat Se Growth Tak, Zero Confusion.
processSection.subhead: Har step pe clear timeline, deliverables, aur accountable owner.

steps.title: Baat (Chai & Discovery)
steps.desc: 20-minute honest conversation over chai (in Jaipur or on call). Hum check karte hain ki hum right fit hain ya nahi.

steps.title: Diagnostic (Paid Audit)
steps.desc: Market, competitors, website UX, SEO aur funnel leaks ka full X-ray. Iske baad aapke paas 90-day blueprint hota hai.

steps.title: Rang-Roop (Design)
steps.desc: Wireframes, brand tokens, bold visual identity aur clickable Figma prototype — taaki build se pehle sab crystal clear ho.

steps.title: Banawat (Build)
steps.desc: Clean code, fast mobile speed, WhatsApp/CRM wiring, GA4 + Pixel events aur accessibility QA.

steps.title: Udaan (Launch)
steps.desc: Zero-downtime launch, Schema.org indexing, speed audit aur 30-day post-launch warranty support.

steps.title: Hawa Banao (Grow)
steps.desc: Performance ads, bilingual reels/content, SEO/AEO compounding aur live dashboard jo aap khud own karte ho.

pillarsSection.nameStory: Naam ka matlab? 'Teer' matlab arrow — aur stretched 'eeeeee' woh awaaz hai jab teer hawa ko cheer ke seedha target pe lagta hai. A flying arrow, aimed at the ordinary.

pillars.title: Strategy Before Execution
pillars.desc: Har retainer se pehle paid Brand & Digital Diagnostic. Bina clarity ke hum ek rupaya bhi ads ya code pe waste nahi karwate.

pillars.title: Creative Technology as One System

pillars.title: Jaipur Roots, Measurable Outcomes

pillars.title: Real Hindi & Regional Capability

pricingSection.headline: Packages & Transparent 'Starting From' Pricing
pricingSection.subhead: Hum fake ₹8,000 wali websites nahi banate — aur na hi random quotes chhupate hain.
pricingSection.whyNot8kTitle: Hum ₹8,000 ki website kyun nahi banate?
pricingSection.whyNot8kBody: ₹8,000 mein sirf ek slow WordPress theme install hoti hai — na positioning research, na conversion copy, na speed optimization, na WhatsApp/CRM setup, aur launch ke baad developer gayab. Aapki website aapka 24/7 sales rep hai; sasta jugaad aapko har mahine leads aur credibility dono mein mehenga padta hai.

testimonialsSection.headline: Client Baat-Cheet (Verified Slots Only)
testimonialsSection.subhead: Hum kabhi fake 'John Doe 5-star' reviews nahi lagate. Jaise-jaise verified partners publish honge, unki real stories yahan aayengi.

faqSection.headline: Jo Sawaal Aapke Dimag Mein Hain — Seedha Jawab

items.a: Bilkul nahi. Har project aapke business model, audience aur brand personality ke hisaab se custom design aur code hota hai. Code aur Figma files aapke naam par rehti hain.

items.q: Launch ke baad gayab toh nahi ho jaoge?
items.a: Never. Har fixed project mein 30 days ka free post-launch support included rehta hai. Uske baad aap optional monthly care plan ya Growth Partnership le sakte hain.

items.q: Ad budget alag kyun hota hai?
items.a: Taaki 100% transparency rahe. Meta aur Google ko ad spend seedha aapke card/account se jaata hai — hum uspe koi hidden commission nahi lagate. Hamari fee sirf strategy, creative aur optimization ki hoti hai.

items.q: Agency quotes itne alag kyun hote hain?
items.a: Kyunki ek template brochure aur ek custom conversion engine mein zameen-aasman ka farq hota hai. Scope, page count, custom integrations, copywriting aur timeline price decide karte hain — isliye hum saaf cost drivers publish karte hain.

items.q: Brand & Digital Diagnostic pehle lena zaroori kyun hai?
items.a: Bina audit ke marketing chalana aankh band karke teer chalane jaisa hai. Diagnostic (7–10 days) mein hum exact leaks aur priorities nikaalte hain, taaki aapka aage ka har rupaya kaam kare.

finalCta.headline: Scene set hai. Ab teer chalayein?
finalCta.subhead: Chahe ₹25,000 ka Diagnostic chahiye ya poora brand + web + growth system — 60 seconds mein apna brief banao ya chai pe baat karo.
